// one-hop-in-a-try: the program is 1608 bytes; the intent 1920 bytes, encoded once (holes: salt, delivered, beneficiary, refundTo, amount)
try { // a program of its own, 1416 bytes to the engine
  const intent = abi.encode(
    8453, // destination: base
    route: abi.encode({
      salt: «salt», // keccak256(abi.encode(baseSalt, ++count)), as it runs
      deadline: 1900000300,
      portal: Portal,
      nativeAmount: 777, // the destination Kitchen's fee
      tokens: [{ token: USDC(base), amount: «delivered» }],
      calls: [
        { target: USDC(base), data: transfer(0x6340080a1967a03caad490a170828d4c59ee5983 /* the shared Pot */, «delivered»), value: 0 },
        { target: 0x6340080a1967a03caad490a170828d4c59ee5983 /* the shared Pot */, data: cook(engine, <body: 527 bytes> ‖ [«beneficiary», «delivered», «refundTo»]), value: 777 },
      ],
    }),
    reward: { deadline: 1900605100, creator: «refundTo», prover: 0xec08fb4647f3f50d1162a578d481266687c60fc5, nativeAmount: 0,
              tokens: [{ token: USDC(ethereum), amount: «amount» }] },
  );
  const [vault] = abi.decode(evm.static(Portal, hex`0742ebe4` ++ intent), ["Address"]); // intentVaultAddress
  USDC.transfer(vault, «amount»);
  evm.call(Portal, 0, hex`645c890c` ++ intent); // publish
} catch (e) { /* the try's handler, here on the source too */ }
